newsitem.title: CANADA: Foreigners buy Canada securities in December.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners buy Canada securities in December.

text.p: Foreign investors bought a net C$3.29 billion of Canadian securities in December after selling a net C$3.52 billion in November (revised from C$3.28 billion), Statistics Canada said on Monday.
For all of 1996, foreign investors bought a net C$18.91 billion of Canadian securities, down from C$22.15 billion in 1995.

Canadian residents bought a net C$3.71 billion of foreign securities after buying C$2.10 billion in November (revised from C$1.96 billion). Over the whole year, they bought a net C$18.39 billion, up sharply from C$5.43 billion in 1995.
